name: Stage 47: Vittenberga to Svärta kyrka
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 47, Vittenberga to Svärta kyrka.
utilities: Vittenberga has bus access and possible small parking at the forest-road entrance; verify signs and live departures.
Svärta has the closest end-side bus stop by the stage junction, while Svärta kyrka has seasonal water, an access-dependent toilet, parking, and church-area transit about 0.4-0.6 km from the trail.
No active food/resupply was confirmed on or within practical range of stage 47. Older Åstugan cafe listings appear closed/outdated; use adjacent-stage logistics such as Oppeby/Nyköping or Tystberga.
waterSources: No reliable mid-stage drinking-water source was found. Carry water from the start.

The only verified refill is the seasonal summer tap at Svärta kyrka, about 20 m left of the church gate per official stage 48 notes; Swedish Church cemetery guidance says taps normally run roughly week 17 to week 40, and a 2025 comment reported the Svärta tap running on May 1. Verify season and current availability.
No lake or stream refill is apparent on this short stage, and Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee natural-water quality.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.
Official distance is 6 km; Naturkartan shows about 5.8 km and the local drawn route is about 5.4 km with endpoints close to official coordinates.

Geometry caveat: Naturkartan/official GPX line is the best display source for the user-facing Stage 47 endpoint near Svärta kyrka/parking, ending around 58.819854,17.080987. OSM relation 7449377 stops around 58.817581,17.078367, about 295 m earlier at the road/stage-48 handoff, so pure OSM builders need to add the church approach or label the shorter handoff carefully.

Easy forest terrain with small rocky rises, mixed path/gravel-road walking, and short road sections near Vittenberga and the Svärta finish. Hiker reports describe a brief steeper climb just after the Vittenberga road crossing and quite a bit of gravel-road walking.

Wreta/Vreta, the former miner dwelling, Vreta gruva, and remnants of De sjungande stenarna are heritage context near the late-stage road section rather than staffed facilities. Keep to the marked route around private property and old mining remains.

Current official page showed no reported faults during the 2026-04-27 research pass. Recent hiker reports still mention high grass/clearing needs in places, young managed forest, road traffic on narrow gravel roads, and autumn elk-hunting activity.

AllTrails and hiker reports generally rate this as easy rather than a highlight stage: short, connective, and culturally interesting, but with managed forest/clear-cut character and meaningful gravel/road walking.

The endpoint named Svärta kyrka is functionally the Svärta road/stage junction, not the church door. Church parking, seasonal tap, toilet and bus-stop context sit about 350-500 m north/east of the stage junction and should not be used to extend the route geometry.

Svärtaån downstream is Natura 2000 with 100 m strandskydd and protected watercourse values. Ordinary walking on the marked route is not a special restriction, but avoid disturbing the watercourse/shore and do not treat the area as a campsite or service zone.

facilities.name: Vittenberga stage 47 start
facilities.description: Official stage start; connects from stage 46. Possible parking east of the road at the forest-road entrance, but verify signs and do not block access.

facilities.name: Vittenberga bus stop
facilities.description: Closest start-side Sörmlandstrafiken stop, roughly 100-150 m from the stage start. Service can be sparse; verify live departures.

facilities.name: Vittenberga opposite-direction bus stop
facilities.description: Opposite-side Vittenberga stop context; no shelter mapped. Verify live Sörmlandstrafiken departures and road crossing.

facilities.name: Vittenberga possible parking
facilities.description: Official text says possible parking on the east side of the road at the forest-road entrance. Treat as small/unsigned parking context until signs are checked.

facilities.name: Vittenberga road/crossing caution
facilities.description: Rural road access and a short initial climb after the road crossing; walk visibly and use care on road sections. Recent reports describe this as the only notably awkward climb.

facilities.name: Stage 47 high grass / clearing watch
facilities.description: A July 2025 trip report found some parts needed clearing and high grass hid foot placement. Conditions vary seasonally; watch footing in summer growth.

facilities.name: Bergtorp private-road context
facilities.description: Blogs mention passing a farm/garden area. Private property context only; stay on marked route/road.

facilities.name: Stavstugan / private torp context
facilities.description: Old torp/farmstead context noted in a 2025 trip report. Private/camera-sign context was reported; keep to the trail.

facilities.name: Wreta / De sjungande stenarna remnants
facilities.description: Approximate route-side cultural marker. Former psalm-stone culture park near Wreta/Vreta; major stones were reportedly moved or sold in 2016, while blogs note remnants.

facilities.name: Wreta private-property context
facilities.description: Wreta/Vreta gård and former parsonage context is private/view-from-route material, not a facility. Stay on the marked trail and roads.

facilities.name: Vretastugan / former miner dwelling
facilities.description: Approximate late-stage heritage context for the former miner dwelling mentioned by Sörmlandsleden near the end of the stage. Historic mine holes/remains occur in the wider Vreta/Svärta area; keep to the marked trail.

facilities.name: Vreta gruva / old mine caution
facilities.description: Approximate old mine-remains context near the Svärta finish. Old sources and local reporting note deep mine-hole hazards in the wider area; do not explore shafts or fenced/posted remains.

facilities.name: Old Riksettan / road-walk caution
facilities.description: Blogs report a short old-road/road-223 approach before the Svärta finish and occasional fast vehicles on narrow gravel-road sections. Use care with traffic.

facilities.name: Svärta stage junction
facilities.description: Stage 47 end and stage 48 start at the Svärta road/stage junction. Despite the stage name, this is not at the church door; church services are a short offset.

facilities.name: Svärta kyrka user-facing endpoint
facilities.description: Naturkartan/official-GPX Stage 47 endpoint and Stage 48 shared church/parking-side point. OSM stage 47 stops about 295 m southwest at the road handoff, so keep this caveat visible in topology/debug views.

facilities.name: Svärta bus stop
facilities.description: Closest end-side bus stop, very near the stage junction. Avoid hardcoding old line numbers; verify live departures with Sörmlandstrafiken.

facilities.name: Svärta kyrka bus stop
facilities.description: Alternative church-side stop about 0.5 km from the stage end and close to the water/church area; verify current service.

facilities.name: Svärta kyrka
facilities.description: Medieval church with 1200s origins, later restorations, and kyrkligt kulturminne status. Useful landmark near the stage end; church access and services can depend on opening/events.

facilities.name: Svärta kyrka summer tap
facilities.description: Official seasonal water tap, about 20 m left of the church gate per stage 48; a 2025 comment reported it running on May 1 and cemetery taps normally run roughly week 17-40. Verify season.

facilities.name: Svärta kyrka toilet
facilities.description: OSM-mapped toilet at/near the church, and church history mentions a toilet built into the entrance area. Treat as church/cemetery-hours dependent, not guaranteed 24/7.

facilities.name: Svärta kyrka access and respect
facilities.description: Active church/churchyard area. Interior access, toilet availability and water can depend on season, opening and services; be quiet around ceremonies and keep dogs leashed on churchyard areas.

facilities.name: Svärta kyrka parking
facilities.description: Church-area parking about 350-400 m north/east of the stage junction; verify signs and event restrictions.

facilities.name: Svärtaån Natura 2000 / strandskydd context
facilities.description: Near the Svärta end/downstream corridor, Svärtaån is Natura 2000 with 100 m strandskydd. Ordinary marked-trail walking is fine, but avoid shore disturbance and do not treat the watercourse edge as a campsite/service area.

facilities.name: Stage 47 hunting-season visibility
facilities.description: A November hiker report encountered active elk hunting. In autumn, wear visible colors, respect signs and hunters, and be prepared for temporary local activity.

facilities.name: Stage 47 fire-risk check
facilities.description: No fireplace was verified on this stage. No formal fire ban was found on 2026-04-27, but status changes quickly; check Nyköping/Sörmlandskustens before any fire or stove use.
